detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Selank TP-7

Chemical Information:
  • Chemical Name: Selank (Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro)
  • Molecular Formula: C33H57N11O9
  • Molecular Weight: 751.9 g/mol
  • Sequence: Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Selank TP-7 is a synthetic heptapeptide originally developed as a stabilized analogue of naturally occurring regulatory peptides. It consists of seven amino acids and is studied in laboratory environments for its biochemical properties, peptide stability, and interaction behavior in controlled experimental systems.
This product is supplied as a pre-formulated aqueous research solution, intended exclusively for laboratory research use.

Research Applications:
  • Investigation of peptide interaction characteristics in vitro
  • Study of peptide stability and enzymatic degradation pathways
  • Evaluation of peptide binding characteristics under laboratory conditions
  • Comparative research involving short-chain peptide structures

 

Storage and Handling:

  • For optimal stability, store sealed product in a cool, dark, and dry environment. Refrigeration at 2–8 °C is recommended after first puncture or once the seal has been compromised
  • Do not freeze
  • Protect from light
  • Handle using aseptic laboratory techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Formulation: Aqueous solution
  • Concentration: 1.33 mg/mL
  • Total Content: 40 mg per bottle
  • Volume: 30 mL
  • Delivery Format: Metered liquid solution
  • Dispoenses per Container: ~200
  • Amount per Dispense: ~200 mcg
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications
Compliance Notice:

Selank TP-7 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
